profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ally
profile.summary: Technologically agile Software Engineer and former Cloud Solutions Architect with extensive experience building high-throughput microservices and cloud-native communications platforms. Proficient in Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS serverless architectures. Pioneered leading edge cloud architecture patterns and lead integrations of APIs with the mobile applications and other complex, uncharted engineering initiatives. Skilled at leveraging AI agents, Claude, and harness engineering to accelerate technical execution, cross-pollinate skills across multi-disciplinary teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Full stack developer working with Java, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript languages for both back-end and front-end development.
▪ Developed cloud apps on AWS ECS based micro-services with cloud app API calls as well as API calls to on-prem apps. Developed AWS Lambda functions to assist with event-driven or timed API calls to assist with the technical workflow.
▪ Delivered business outcome for client through file parsing and processing in a python based lambda with read and writes to S3 buckets.
▪ Utilized the small-footprint and CI/CD capable lambda functions to replace on-prem based cron triggers to further enhance application reliability while increasing monitoring capabilities. Following these features, lambda functions to monitor production flow were deployed to aid in overall systems stability.
▪ Modernized on-prem batch application by porting business logic onto AWS ECS based web app that processes and enriches request objects of parsed client files with business data for further validation and eventual submission to LOB app.
▪ Worked with and utilized agile methodology in order to bring features to production based on client requirements while having the ability to switch to production support development when the need arose.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Three month full-time coding bootcamp program that covered technologies such as HTML, CSS, Javascript, node.js, express, MySQL, MongoDB, and React App.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
▪	Technical resource in Independent Software Vendor organization for Business Development Consultants on discovery calls.
▪	Managed and documented POC process with partners as well as providing hands-on-keyboard assistance with Oracle Cloud technology in addition to providing technical tools such as the software delivery cloud (on-prem dev licenses), git repositories, and demo environments suitable for their purposes. 
▪	Whiteboard/presentation sessions on Oracle/Partner technology stack, process flow, and technical business value for the technical and non-technical sales team.
▪	Active creation of web-diagrams by translating from description of technology components and the relationship between components and external end-points. (For own projects as well as for other sales engineers)
